FX-AUTO-001.says: Stretch Levels as added, clips 0.1 per cent: each channel of the dull, warm drawing stretched to its own darkest and lightest, so the darkest grey nears black, the lightest white, and the warm cast is lessened.

FX-AUTO-002.says: Stretch Levels, clips 5 per cent: the darkest and lightest 5 per cent of each channel go to black and white.

FX-AUTO-003.says: Stretch Levels, clips 0: the drawing's own darkest and lightest in each channel become exactly 0 and 255.

FX-AUTO-004.says: Stretch Contrast as added: one stretch for the three channels together, so the warm cast stays.

FX-AUTO-006.says: Stretch Color as added: the darkest pixels' colour goes to black and the lightest pixels' to white.

FX-AUTO-007.says: Stretch Color with Snap Neutral Midtones: the average colour is taken to a grey as well.

FX-AUTO-008.says: Stretch Color, clips 5 per cent, Snap Neutral Midtones.

FX-AUTO-009.says: Stretch Levels at Mix 50, Blend With Original 50 per cent: halfway between the drawing and FX-AUTO-001.

FX-AUTO-010.says: A Levels lowering output white to 128, then Stretch Levels: the statistics are of the darkened picture, so the full range comes back.

FX-AUTO-011.says: Stretch Levels, then a Levels lowering output white to 128: the stretched picture darkened.

FX-AUTO-012.says: Stretch Levels on each frame of the flicker by itself: frames 1 and 2, a brighter and a darker copy of frame 0, are each stretched by their own statistics.

FX-AUTO-013.says: Stretch Levels, Temporal Smoothing 0.1 seconds, two frames each side: frame 0 reads frames 0 to 2 (the two before are outside the layer); frame 3 reads 1 to 5, across the cut; frame 7 reads 5 to 7.

FX-AUTO-014.says: FX-AUTO-013 with Scene Detect: frame 3 reads only 1 to 3 and frame 4 only 4 to 6, each side of the cut.

FX-AUTO-015.says: Stretch Color, Temporal Smoothing 0.1, Scene Detect and Snap Neutral Midtones.

FX-AUTO-017.says: A Levels lowering output white to 128, then Stretch Levels with Temporal Smoothing 0.1: every frame read is the darkened picture.

FX-AUTO-018.says: Spread Tones as added, RGB: each channel's values spread evenly over 0 to 255 by its own histogram.

FX-AUTO-019.says: Spread Tones, Photoshop Style: one histogram of the three channels for all.

FX-AUTO-020.says: Spread Tones, Brightness: each pixel scaled so its brightness is spread.

FX-AUTO-022.says: Stretch Levels on an adjustment layer above the holder: the frame beneath is the drawing, so FX-AUTO-001.

FX-AUTO-023.says: Stretch Levels with Temporal Smoothing 0.1 on an adjustment layer: the frames beneath at other times are not to hand, so each frame is stretched by itself, with a warning each frame.

FX-AUTO-024.says: Black clip keyed from 0 at frame 0 to 10 at frame 4: 5 at frame 2.

FX-AUTO-025.says: FX-AUTO-001 with the holder moved 3 pixels right, its last columns off the composition: the statistics are of the whole layer, so the same, moved.

FX-AUTO-026.says: Black clip 11, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AUTO-027.says: White clip -1, below 0. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AUTO-028.says: Temporal Smoothing 11 seconds, above 10. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AUTO-029.says: Scene Detect written "yes". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AUTO-030.says: Snap Neutral Midtones written "maybe". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AUTO-031.says: Spread Tones' equalize written "hsl". The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.

FX-AUTO-032.says: Spread Tones' amount 101, above 100. The file is read, the effect is kept as written and left out of every frame, with a warning.
